name: diffsense
description: Structured, severity-tagged code review of a local git diff or a GitHub PR. Produces an end-user Summary, a top-level "Actionable comments posted" count with a combined AI-agent fix prompt + walkthrough, and inline findings tagged two-dimensionally by issue type (Functional Correctness, Security & Privacy, Data Integrity & Integration, Maintainability, Test Coverage) and severity (Minor/Major/Nitpick), each with a Proposed fix, a committable suggestion patch, and a per-finding AI-agent prompt. Report-only by default (prints in terminal, never edits code); can optionally post to a PR and run the confirm-on-fix resolve loop.
